# Grégoire Darcy

> PhD candidate in cognitive science at Institut Jean Nicod, École Normale Supérieure (ENS-PSL). Research on trust, cooperation, social norms, misinformation, and public policy. Teaches cognitive science applied to public policy, strategic affairs, and cognitive warfare at ENS-PSL, Paris-Dauphine, Sciences Po Paris, and the École de Guerre. Author of "La désinformation" (Éditions La Découverte, 2026). Normalien (ENS Rennes, Promotion 2020, ranked 1st at national entrance exam). Writes policy briefs for the French Presidency on disinformation and STEM gender gaps.

## Research Areas
- Psychology and Public Policies
- Trust, Cooperation, and Social Norms
- Psychology of Misinformation and Disinformation
- Cognitive and Behavioral Approaches to Law and Regulation
- Cognitive Warfare and Counter-Propaganda
- Experimental Jurisprudence

## Selected Publications

- Darcy, G. (2026). Désinformation en France : sortir de la spirale de la défiance. Futuribles, 474(5), 21-44. DOI: 10.3917/futur.474.0021
- Darcy, G., Fitouchi, L., Thouzeau, V., André, J.-B., & Chevallier, C. (under review at Nature Communications). Trust miscalibration across cultures and social classes. PsyArXiv: https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/wb7am_v1
- Darcy, G. & Altay, S. (under review). Disinformation in Practice: Threats, Actors, Mechanisms, and Constraints According to Professionals. PsyArXiv: https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/jkqwh_v1
- Dubourg, E., Thouzeau, V., Freynet, R., Darcy, G., Beuchot, T., Noël, N., Chevallier, C., & Baumard, N. (under review). Personality structure predicts story preferences across 23 countries. PsyArXiv: https://osf.io/preprints/psyarxiv/v3ecq_v1
- Darcy, G., Fitouchi, L., André, J.-B., & Baumard, N. (in preparation). The paradox of cultural tightness: Low-cooperation individuals promote high-cooperation norms.

## Theatre
Writer and resident actor for mock literary trials at Théâtre de Poche-Montparnasse (2024–present, 10+ performances). Repertoire: Le Procès de la Panthère des neiges, Le Procès des Piliers de la mer (with Sylvain Tesson), Le Procès d'Antigone (as Creon), Le Procès de Tristan et Iseult (as Tristan, with Michel Zink), Le Procès de La Fontaine (as prosecutor).
